reporting-org.narrative: Department for Environment, Food, and Rural Affairs

description.narrative: In the context of supporting the monitoring framework of the KMGBF, Defra is exploring how to catalyse new ways of monitoring ecosystems and biodiversity in developing countries, and the role that improved data might have in unlocking nature finance by improving investor confidence. Innovate 4 Nature will assess the demand for innovative monitoring technology, skills and infrastructure by developing use cases in one or more lower- or middle-income country. It will evaluate who the potential users are and how improved biodiversity data and insight could improve livelihoods, reduce poverty, attract investment, and improve ecosystem protection or restoration. For specific use cases, the programme will explore which technologies or methods would be applicable, how they could be packaged, what the specific barriers to uptake are and how they may be overcome, facilitating more accessible, affordable and effective biodiversity monitoring.
